**Easy Reader, alpha.** Read PDFs aloud with the spoken sentence and word highlighted, mark and comment, in German and English. Nothing leaves your computer except sync with your own phone and Nextcloud.

### Installing

These builds are **not signed with a purchased certificate**, so the system warns once:

- **Windows** (`…-setup.exe`): SmartScreen says "unknown publisher". Choose _More info_, then _Run anyway_.
- **Mac** (`….dmg`, Apple Silicon only): open the disk image, drag _Easy Reader_ to Applications, then **right-click it and choose Open** the first time (or System Settings → Privacy & Security → _Open Anyway_).

The installer is large (about 700 MB) because it carries the speech voices, so that nothing is downloaded when you use it. Settings, notes and paired phones of earlier versions are kept.

The Android app is a separate release in the `pdfreader_flutter` repository.
